title: Radicalvice's Less Unfortunate-Looking Wildlife
description: Gives Minecraft's wildlife a much-needed rework.
body:
# This mod requires [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) and [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) to work.

**Radicalvice's Less Unfortunate-Looking Wildlife** aims to freshen up Minecraft's uglier creatures to make them feel more at home with the game's more recent additions.

 Let's be honest, this is barely even a cow. It looks like it crawled out of a nuclear power plant.
![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/793659b0ece47837476e018ddc8822277d8adacb.png)

Not every mob is going to get a rework. This resource pack focuses on older, animalistic mobs.

**Credits:**

<details>

- [Wakes](https://modrinth.com/mod/wakes);
